study type: network meta-analysis of randomised controlled studies
exposure: pharmacological strategies to mitigate haemodynamic instability
cohort: The study included 619 parturient women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy undergoing caesarean section under general anaesthesia.
finding: High-dose remifentanil was most effective in minimizing blood pressure changes, while labetalol was most effective in maintaining a normal heart rate in hypertensive parturient women undergoing caesarean section, and low-dose remifentanil resulted in higher 1-minute Apgar scores compared to high-dose.
